title: Evaluating Confidence-Gated Retrieval with Matched Trajectory Replay
abstract: arXiv:2608.26846v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Interactive language-model agents use confidence signals to decide whether to answer immediately, retrieve additional evidence (from memory or external knowledge), or defer. Yet confidence is usually evaluated in isolation, without measuring the trajectory-level consequences of the actions it triggers. We propose matched trajectory replay, a controlled protocol for comparing confidence-to-action mappings. The protocol holds candidate answer states, evidence points, budgets, and action costs fixed. We use it to compare raw verbalized confidence with post-hoc isotonic calibration in a multi-hop question-answering system using Mistral, GPT, and Qwen models on HotpotQA and MuSiQue datasets. At the same numerical commitment threshold, calibration changes which questions agents ultimately commit to answering. translated_title: 评估匹配轨迹回放的置信门控检索
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.26846v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：交互式语言模型代理使用置信信号来决定是立即回答、检索额外证据（从记忆或外部知识），还是延迟回答。然而，置信度通常是在孤立情况下评估的，没有测量其触发动作的轨迹级后果。我们提出匹配轨迹回放，这是一种用于比较置信度到动作映射的受控协议。该协议保持候选答案状态、证据点、预算和动作成本固定。我们使用它来比较原始口头化置信度与事后等渗校准，在多跳问答系统中使用Mistral、GPT和Qwen模型，在HotpotQA和MuSiQue数据集上进行测试。在相同的数值承诺阈值下，校准改变了代理最终承诺回答的问题。在所有六种模型-数据集对中，它使承诺答案的准确率提高了多达41个百分点。然而，它可能减少...
tldr: 该论文提出匹配轨迹回放协议，发现事后等渗校准在相同阈值下改变代理的承诺决策，显著提升已承诺答案的准确率（最高达41个百分点），但可能减少回答范围。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes matched trajectory replay and finds that post-hoc isotonic calibration changes which questions agents commit to, boosting committed-answer accuracy by up to 41 percentage points across six model-dataset pairs, though it may reduce coverage.
